modelCatalogEntry.name: inclusionAI: Ling 3.1 Flash
modelCatalogEntry.description: Ling 3.1 Flash is a hybrid reasoning mixture-of-experts model from inclusionAI, with 25B active parameters out of 560B total.

message.content:
I appreciate the enthusiasm, but I'm a text-based AI — I've got no shovel, no body, and definitely no access to your terrain. I can't dig anything remotely physical. 😄

That said, here's what I **can** do:

🏰 **If this is chess** — I can help you build a defensive "moat" around your king (solid pawn structure, fortress setup, etc.). Just share the position.

🗺️ **If this is a game** (Minecraft, RollerCoaster Tycoon, Dwarf Fortress, etc.) — tell me the game and I'll walk you through where and how to dig.

🌊 **If this is landscaping** — I can give you advice on planning a real ornamental moat: depth, width, water management, permits, liner options.

📝 **If this is metaphorical** — I can help you build a "moat" around your business, project, or ideas (competitive advantages, defensibility).

So — which moat are we talking about? Give me a bit of context and I'll bring the blueprint. ⛏️

responseStoragePolicy: Private reasoning fields removed; only public final answer and metadata retained.
